expected: Probe: the first screenshot shows the game's title ('Press any key'); after one A the game's screen changes. If the presses do not change the game's screen, stop: COULD NOT RUN.
verdict: COULD NOT RUN - SCR-10 (frame rate in a mission): the game's window never came to the front of the screen, so the rig's presses reached Steam Home and the game's page, not the game. Resume on the game page was one press away; I did not take it because the runbook does not describe it.
COULD NOT RUN - GAME-LIGHT-01, STREAM-PIECES-01, SCR-03: depend on the same live game screen.
